title: Repairs of Damaged or Old Drains to Prevent Water Stagnation and Mosquito Breeding
what_it_is: Repairs of Damaged or Old Drains to Prevent Water Stagnation and Mosquito Breeding

sections.label: Drain inspection, repair and cleaning
sections.summary: PUB inspects and repairs drains, upgrading severely worn ones, while NEA cleans public drains to keep stormwater flowing and prevent stagnant water.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB regularly inspects and upkeeps our drains to ensure their performance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Drains that show minor damage will be repaired promptly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Such repair works will be prioritised based on the drain conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Drains that are found to have severe structural wear beyond repair will be upgraded as soon as possible through PUB's drainage improvement programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA undertakes the regular cleaning of public drains.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Debris, litter and shed leaves in the drains are removed promptly to allow stormwater to flow freely and to prevent pockets of stagnant water from forming.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Drains are also flushed periodically to remove silt.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB and NEA will continue to keep our drains and waterways clean and in good condition, so as to better protect Singaporeans from floods and vector-borne diseases like dengue.
